verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms dLocal serves llms.txt at docs.dlocal.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). A dedicated 'Using LLMs' docs page documents plain-text Markdown versions of every guide page via a `.md` suffix, plus links to AI assistants. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the llms.txt/Markdown docs effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.dlocal.com/llms.txt # dLocal Docs Documentation
You can access our guide documentation as plain text Markdown files by adding `.md` to the end of any URL.
It links to AI assistants (ChatGPT and Claude) that can explain concepts, answer questions, or generate code examples based on the page content.
